variants.title: 01 · 화이트 프리시전
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Revise a Korean industrial company homepage concept based on the attached two previous drafts and client feedback. Create ONE flat straight-on high fidelity DESKTOP full homepage screenshot in a 1024x1536 portrait canvas (or 1536x2304 same ratio). No browser chrome, device, mockup background, outer frame or annotations. Reference image 1 is the preferred A: take its clarity and balanced hierarchy. Reference image 2 is REJECTED overall: take ONLY its more prominently framed conveyor and punchy hero, absolutely remove its catalog/search/filter/spec-table layout.
Client mandates: EVERY NON-PHOTO PAGE SURFACE IS PURE WHITE #FFFFFF, including hero whitespace, sections, inquiry and footer. NO colored section backgrounds, NO cream, NO pale gray panels, NO navy/black footer, NO blue inquiry stripe. Natural color and shadows INSIDE real photographs are permitted. Small text/links may use crisp blue #1559EB; buttons are WHITE with dark text and a thin dark outline, no colored fill. All typography is modern clean Korean sans serif (Pretendard-like), graphite #171B20, never serif. Contemporary technical-brand art direction: bold disciplined typography, immaculate generous white space, real photographic detail, large product scale, minimal structure. Not an old factory template, a stock-photo brochure, a crowded product catalog or a SaaS dashboard.
Retain fictional brand HANGYEOL TECH / 한결테크. Fine white header with wordmark left, nav 회사소개 / 사업소개 / 제품소개 / 납품사례 / 고객지원, one text-arrow 견적 문의 at right.
Same hero words in all drafts, exactly: "현장에 맞는 설비,\n정확한 도입의 시작." Supporting line "설비 선정부터 설치와 유지관리까지 함께합니다." Primary link/button "제품 살펴보기 ↗". Products are the SAME recognizable dark-belt aluminum conveyor "모듈형 벨트 컨베이어" model HC-200, compact camera inspection device "비전 검사 유닛" HV-30, and metal workbench "조립형 작업대" HW-1200. Product studio photographs must have genuinely white seamless backgrounds merging with the WHITE page, never boxed gray backdrops. Use calm photoreal metal equipment, mechanically plausible. Case title "포장 공정 이송라인 구축". Closing phrase "다음 현장을 함께 만듭니다." and link "견적 문의 ↗". Tiny footer "가상 기업 · 테마 디자인 시안".
Do not put Korean signage in photographs. No fake claims/numbers/awards, price tables, spec tables, search bars, category icon strips, numbered 01/02/03 service bar, statistic strip, micro-eyebrows repeated everywhere, 3D illustration, gradient, heavy shadow, small inset photo mosaics, rounded cards, phone/email placeholder contacts. Body below hero has only a few large legible moments with ONE alignment system; never cram many business modules across the middle/lower page. Omit auxiliary technical-document/notice/service boxes: those remain reachable from nav in the future implementation. Show a beautifully complete page, ending in generous WHITE inquiry and WHITE footer.
ART DIRECTION 01: A sophisticated refinement of A with the striking conveyor hero impact of C. White header 5% canvas. Hero about 33% canvas height: ONE panoramic photograph runs edge-to-edge, showing an extremely well lit modern assembly hall, massive conveyor at right extending diagonally toward the viewer in the foreground; left half remains a naturally clean WHITE area for bold black Korean title on TWO lines. Subject should feel much larger and more assertive than reference A, not buried in scenery. It is a unified photographic composition, not 2 rounded panels. No gradient overlay effect. Title strongly readable, lots of white breathing space around CTA.
After hero give a generous whitespace gap. "현장에 맞는 제품" section: heading left and subtle "전체 제품 보기 ↗" right, one airy 3-column row of white-background product photographs, short model and Korean name below, NO card containers. Products take roughly 24% height with ample white margin.
Next case section takes about 23%: single wide landscape factory image across 62% left and clean title plus just one short sentence at right, no inset mosaic. Closing 15% on WHITE: oversized black "다음 현장을 함께 만듭니다." left, small thin-outline inquiry button right, then white thin-rule footer. The key is immaculate precision, alignment and photo scale, modern premium technology identity.
IMPLEMENTATION-AWARE VISUAL CONTRACT, identical across these three proposals: frontend is React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4 with jw prefix and scoped design tokens, a 4/8px spacing scale, desktop max content width around 1200px with 40px gutters, section spacing around 96px. Responsive grid/flex, natural image aspect-ratios, no impossible overlapping text/shapes. ALL PRIMARY CTA controls share one conventional white outlined rectangle: approximately 44-48px high at desktop reference scale, 1px graphite outline, 4px corner radius, 16px medium sans label, 16px horizontal padding and 8px label/icon gap. Secondary action is a plain text link. Icons: exclusively simple Lucide-compatible 20px line icons such as ArrowUpRight / ArrowRight, stroke 1.75-2, same baseline, no custom pictogram illustrations or emoji. Do not draw icons decoratively to fill space. System-ui Korean sans metrics, no extra display font requirement. Runtime can use optional Motion/Embla but this still-image design must not depend on animation, autoplay or parallax for legibility. No UI widget requiring new framework or not-yet-approved headless library. Need modern premium design while faithfully implementable with standard Tailwind/CSS, real text, images and native controls.
